winning_hook_formulas: The 'Stop Doing X' Warning: Start with an urgent imperative that challenges a common financial habit before revealing a specific, actionable risk.
The 'Hidden Loss' Reveal: Highlight a specific, relatable financial product (FDs, homes) and contrast its perceived safety with a harsh, quantified reality (inflation, purchasing power).
script_directives: Keep total duration strictly under 22 seconds to maintain high completion rates.
Use a 'Problem-Agitation-Solution' structure where the agitation is a specific, quantifiable financial threat.
Eliminate all jargon and filler; every sentence must introduce a new, high-stakes piece of information to prevent drop-offs.
seo_directives: Use high-intent, searchable keywords in the title (e.g., 'Nifty', 'Stocks', 'FD') rather than vague clickbait.
Limit hashtags to 3 highly relevant tags (e.g., #StockMarketIndia #PersonalFinance #Investing) to keep the focus on the content value.
